scope: Driver basic performance display and authenticated support integration; not full v1.6 rollout

performance.window: Up to last 100 verified explicit personal responses and last 100 verified financial acceptances, separately
performance.acceptance: Accepted / (accepted + explicitly declined); undelivered/unconfirmed expiries never become declines. This is provisional observed acceptance when unknown history exists, not a claimed full delivered-offer rate.
performance.completion: (Settled deliveries + confirmed settled returns) / (fulfilled commitments + cancellations with confirmed 100% driver responsibility)
performance.fairness: In-progress, unknown/reassigned and mixed responsibility excluded, shown separately; client/admin cancellation alone never establishes driver fault
performance.reading: Paginated GSI discovery, strong row/order/case reads, deduped offer and commitment identities, bounded time/pages; incomplete coverage marked provisional
performance.ratings: Verified customer average/count, no fabricated legacy rating; fixes DriverService dropping fields
performance.dispatch: No writes to legacy metrics/live snapshots and no policy/eligibility/ranking changes

support.protocol: Colleague deployed JWT/role/session-owner guarded support service
support.client: Signed-in identity only; token in Authorization header; isolated saved sessions; server-confirmed handshake and message receipts; idempotent uncertain-send retry; history cursor/retry; session-closed and resume handling; subscriptions/timers disposed
support.production: Requires explicit SUPPORT_CHAT_WS_URL; no automatic fallback to staging outside staging
support.scopeLimit: Text support and receipt/history recovery. Existing image references are identified; image upload/view expansion is not claimed here.

checks.sourceAnalysis: No errors/warnings in new support/performance files; style informational lints remain

publication.requestedChange: Add two-file read-only performance endpoint to DriversApi-staging and exact GetItem/Query permissions for WaveOffers_staging and its driver index; preserve all other bundle entries and configuration

humanAcceptance: Pending after approved publication and installation
